paragraphs: Mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat, chapter 12, halakhah 4, reporting in the name of the rabbis there.[^1]

notes.text: רבנן דתמן means the rabbis there. Babylonia was an earlier interpretive addition and is not in the supplied words. The reporting subject is understood from the heading; no teaching content is supplied. The source explicitly gives Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat chapter 12 halakhah 4, without independent named-edition verification. The subject’s abbreviated title remains R'; the collective rabbis is full רבנן.
